campusPages.text: Alpha Miami K-12 Private School in Miami, Florida STAY IN-THE-KNOW Attend an Info Session Book A Call Apply now Welcome to the Future of Education in Miami​ Looking for a private school your child can’t wait to go to each morning? At Alpha Miami, our mastery-based, AI driven approach allows students to crush their academics in 2 hours. Our classes rank in the top 1% nationally. Personalized Learning The rest of the day is spent on life skills and team-based workshops that ignite motivation and teach things like leadership, grit, financial literacy & entrepreneurship. At Alpha Miami, kids love school. We’re not just preparing students for tests; we’re preparing them for limitless futures. Attend an Info Session Alpha Miami is open and enrolling.Join us for an info session at our campus at 8000 SW 56th St, conveniently located across the street from Tropical Park in Glenvar Heights, and see firsthand why Alpha is ranked among the best private schools thanks to its groundbreaking learning model. See How Alpha Transforms Kids: Straight From Miami Parents When choosing a school, nothing matters more than hearing from families just like yours.These Miami parents share how their children gained confidence, learned faster, and rediscovered their love of school. See More Stories From Alpha Parents Ready to see what these parents are talking about?Join an Information Session In one evening, you’ll see how Alpha kids learn twice as fast, meet guides, and talk with parents whose kids are already thriving. Walk away knowing whether Alpha is the right fit for your child.Save Your Spot See All Upcoming Events Alpha Miami Private School K - 12th Grade 8000 SW 56th St, Miami, FL 33155 Tuition $50,000 Email: admissions.miami@alpha.school Telephone: (786) 254-4288 Quick Resources ADMISSION GUIDE 2025/26 INFO PACKET 2026/27 calendar 2026/27 INFO PACKET Book a Call Apply for K–8 Apply for High School Alpha Miami Gallery More Real Stories From Alpha Families All2X LearningAlpha SummerKindergartenLife SkillsLove SchoolParent TestimonialsShadow DaysStudent TestimonialsThe First 30 Daystimeback× Looking for more stories to view and share? Explore the full video library Alpha Miami FAQs What communities does Alpha Miami serve? Alpha Miami is located just off SW 56th Street serving families from Palmetto Bay, Pinecrest, South Miami, High Pines, Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Brickell, Key Biscayne, Doral, and nearby areas. If you live near any of these ZIP codes 33157, 33156, 33134, 33130, 33131, 33174, 33165, 33173, 33149, among others, Alpha Miami delivers an innovative and personalized education for your children. How did you choose the location? We explored many spaces across Miami, and this one stood out. It offered the right blend of flexibility, safety, design potential, and proximity to key hubs like University of Miami, Coral Gables, and the Palmetto Expressway that offers easy access from all Miami neighborhoods. How much outdoor time do students get? Every school day includes 60–90 minutes of outdoor play, weather permitting. Students often explore nearby green spaces like Tropical Park or enjoy movement games and biking in our own outdoor areas. Our Miami location also takes advantage of proximity to destinations like the Miami Zoo, stables in South Miami’s Horse Country, Olympic-size pools at nearby Miami Dade College, Marine Lab, and more! Fresh air and sunshine are built into our day! How is learning personalized? Each Alpha student follows a customized learning path built with adaptive apps that adjust in real time to their progress. Our Miami students are mastering core subjects at their own pace:with no gaps, no burnout, and no unnecessary review.Outside of academics, guides work 1:1 with students to set goals and choose workshops:from marine science to digital storytelling:based on interests. Whether a student lives in Fontainebleau or South Miami Heights, they’re on a path that fits them perfectly. Is Alpha Miami open? Yes, Alpha Miami is open and enrolling for K–10. Since we launched in Fall 2024, we’ve been actively growing. So, if you’d like to tour the campus or connect with a current family, we’d love to show you around. What's the daily schedule? The daily schedule at Alpha runs from 8:15 AM to 4:00 PM. Students arrive for morning drop-off at 8:15–8:30 AM, and the day finishes with afternoon pick-up between 3:30–4:00 PM.You can find more information on what an Alpha day looks like in the Info Packet linked above. What grades does Alpha Miami serve? Alpha Miami currently presents itself as a K–12 private school and says the campus is open and enrolling. Families should confirm current grade placement and availability through admissions. Is Alpha Miami an elementary and middle school option? Yes. Alpha Miami’s K–12 grade scope includes elementary and middle-school years. Students use the same personalized, mastery-based academic model, with age-appropriate Guide coaching and workshops. What makes Alpha Miami different from a traditional private-school model? Alpha Miami concentrates personalized core academics into a focused two-hour block using adaptive learning tools. The remaining school day is used for workshops, collaborative projects, and practical skill development. Is Alpha Miami a good fit for advanced or self-paced learners? The mastery-based model can support students ready to move faster because progress depends on demonstrated understanding rather than a fixed whole-class pace. Guides monitor progress and help learners stay challenged and supported. How does Alpha Miami use AI in academics? AI-supported learning applications adjust difficulty and pacing based on each student’s work. They help personalize core subjects, while Guides coach goals, motivation, and learning habits. What life skills does Alpha Miami teach? Alpha’s life-skills workshops cover areas such as leadership, public speaking, entrepreneurship, financial literacy, teamwork, relationship building, socialization, grit, and hard work. What should families verify before applying? Review the current Miami campus and admissions pages, then confirm grade placement, tuition, enrollment status, daily schedule, workshops, and application steps directly with admissions. Alpha Miami is a candidate for accreditation with Cognia Alpha Miami is accredited by Cognia

Explore the full video library Alpha New York FAQs What communities does Alpha serve? Alpha serves families across Lower Manhattan, including the Financial District, Tribeca, Battery Park City, the Lower East Side, and Greenwich Village, as well as nearby Chelsea. Thanks to easy ferry access, we also welcome families from Brooklyn neighborhoods such as Brooklyn Heights and Park Slope. In addition, we support families from surrounding areas and boroughs, offering a convenient and innovative option for those seeking personalized education in New York City. If you live near ZIP codes 10005, 10006, 10007, 10038, 10002, 10003, 10011, or 11201, Alpha is here for you. How did you choose the location? We chose 180 Maiden Lane because it offers the perfect mix of accessibility and community. It’s close to families in Lower Manhattan and easily reached by ferry for Brooklyn parents. Just as importantly, our partnership with the building’s developer:who shared our enthusiasm for bringing a groundbreaking, personalized education model to New York:made this the ideal home for Alpha’s first NYC campus. How much outdoor time do students get? Every school day includes around 60 minutes of unstructured play, weather permitting. Students often head to nearby play spaces like the Imagination Playground, just one block from our campus, for active outdoor play. In addition, we offer a movement-based workshop twice a week:usually on Tuesdays and Thursdays:ensuring kids stay active, energized, and connected to their environment. How is learning personalized? Each Alpha student follows a customized learning path supported by adaptive apps that adjust in real time to their progress. Students master core subjects at their own pace:no gaps, no burnout, no unnecessary repetition. Beyond academics, Teachers work one-on-one with students to set goals and choose workshops based on their interests:from creative storytelling to robotics:so each learner thrives in a way that fits them perfectly. What's the daily schedule? The daily schedule at Alpha runs from 8:15 AM to 4:00 PM. Students arrive for morning drop-off at 8:15–8:30 AM, and the day finishes with afternoon pick-up between 3:30–4:00 PM.You can find more information on what an Alpha day looks like in the Info Packet linked above. What is Alpha New York? Alpha New York serves K-12 students at 180 Maiden Lane in Lower Manhattan. What makes Alpha New York’s learning model different from a traditional school? Alpha structures a full school day around a focused morning academic block, then workshops. Students use AI-supported, mastery-based tools that adjust to their level and pace, while Guides (educators, coaches, and mentors) provide instruction, feedback, coaching, and individualized support. How does Alpha New York personalize learning? Students progress through core subjects at their own pace and advance when they demonstrate mastery. Adaptive technology adjusts difficulty and pacing, while Guides monitor progress and step in with coaching or support when needed. How does the morning academic block use AI? AI-supported learning tools personalize the sequence, difficulty, and pace of core academic work. Concentrating that work into a focused morning block leaves more of the day for collaborative projects, workshops, and real-world skill development. Is Alpha New York a fit for advanced or self-paced learners? Alpha’s mastery-based model can fit students who are ready to move faster because progress is based on demonstrated understanding, not a whole-class calendar. Students can move ahead in areas of strength while receiving targeted support elsewhere. How does Alpha New York combine academics and life skills? After focused core academics, students participate in structured workshops that develop skills such as leadership, communication, teamwork, entrepreneurship, financial literacy, relationship building, and grit. What does a Guide do at Alpha New York? Guides are educators, coaches, and mentors. They provide instruction, feedback, coaching, and individualized support. They monitor academic progress, help students set goals, support motivation and learning habits, and guide students through personalized coursework. How does Alpha New York build student independence? Independence is built into the daily structure rather than taught separately. Students advance when they demonstrate mastery instead of moving on a whole-class calendar, set goals with a Guide who provides instruction, feedback, and coaching, and help choose the workshops they take. What should families verify before applying? Families should review the current campus page and admissions materials, then ask about grade placement, daily schedule, tuition, enrollment availability, workshops, and fit. Alpha New York currently presents itself as serving K–12. What should New York City parents compare when choosing a private school? Compare five things: how the school paces advancement, the adult-to-student ratio, how progress is measured and reported, what the afternoon actually contains, and total annual cost including aid. Ask how many hours a day are direct instruction versus independent or project work, and ask what a typical Tuesday looks like. Who is Alpha New York not the right fit for? Alpha New York fits students comfortable working at their own pace with a Guide's coaching: mornings are a focused two-hour core academic block, afternoons are workshops. Families who want traditional whole-class lessons, a fixed grade-level calendar, or a pre-K program should look elsewhere — the campus page states it serves K–12th grade. How much does Alpha New York cost? Alpha School lists Alpha New York's tuition amount on its New York City campus page. Tuition is set per campus, so confirm the amount for your application year with New York admissions at admissions.newyork@alpha.school or (646) 363-6678. A $1,000 deposit secures an offered place and is credited toward tuition; enrolled siblings after the first receive 5% off. How do families apply to Alpha New York? Alpha New York's campus page links to three next steps: an info session, a booked call, and the online application. It also links Alpha's admission guide and the current info packet. For grade placement or timeline questions, email admissions.newyork@alpha.school or call (646) 363-6678. Is Alpha New York a private elementary school? Alpha New York serves K-12 students at 180 Maiden Lane in Lower Manhattan, which includes the elementary grades. Is Alpha New York a private middle school? Alpha New York serves K-12 students at 180 Maiden Lane in Lower Manhattan, which includes the middle grades. Is Alpha New York an alternative or innovative private school? Alpha New York is an innovative option for families seeking personalized education in New York City. The campus runs a full school day: a focused morning block of AI-supported, mastery-based core academics, then workshops and projects. Is Alpha New York a future-ready school? Alpha New York pairs mastery-based core academics with daily workshops in leadership, communication, teamwork, entrepreneurship, financial literacy, relationship building, and grit. Students build real-world skills for their future by practicing them throughout the school day, not only during academic time. We serve families from many areas in Fort Worth and Dallas:Aledo, Tanglewood, Ridglea, Arbor Lawn, Crowley, Arlington, Keller, Southlake, Colleyville, Richardson, Highland Park and other DFW areas. If you live near any of these ZIP codes 76107, 76109, 76110, 76248, 76034, 75081, 75205, among others, Alpha Fort Worth delivers an innovative and personalized education for your children. Do you provide transportation? At this time, Alpha Fort Worth does not offer a formal transportation service. However, distance hasn’t stopped families from joining our community! Many coordinate carpools, and we actively help connect parents who live near one another. As our community grows, we’re exploring ways to expand transportation options so families across the metroplex can access Alpha’s unique model. How much outdoor time do students get? Every school day includes 60–90 minutes of outdoor play, weather permitting. They also have access to the racquetball courts, expansive fields, and large indoor gymnasium within the CERA center for free play as well as for structured activities. Students also often enjoy movement-based games and activities in nearby green spaces like River Park and Trinity Trails. Our location also takes advantage of proximity to destinations like the award-winning Fort Worth Zoo, the Stockyards, the Water Gardens, facilities at nearby Texas Christian University, and more! Our Fort Worth students are mastering core subjects at their own pace:with no gaps, no burnout, and no unnecessary review.Outside of academics, guides work 1:1 with students to set goals and choose exciting workshops:anything from aviation to zoology:based on their unique interests! Whether a student lives in Aledo or Southlake, they’re on a path that fits them perfectly. Is Alpha Fort Worth open? Yes, Alpha Fort Worth is open and enrolling for K–8. Since we launched in Fall 2025, we’ve been actively growing. So, if you’d like to tour the campus or connect with a current family, we’d love to show you around. What's the daily schedule? The daily schedule at Alpha runs from 8:15 AM to 4:00 PM. Students arrive for morning drop-off at 8:15–8:30 AM, and the day finishes with afternoon pick-up between 3:30–4:00 PM.You can find more information on what an Alpha day looks like in the Info Packet linked above. Is Alpha Fort Worth a K–8 private school? Alpha Fort Worth currently presents itself as a K–8 private school in Fort Worth, Texas. The campus includes elementary and middle-school years, with current placement and availability confirmed through admissions. Students progress at an individualized pace rather than following one fixed whole-class lesson schedule. How does Alpha Fort Worth teach core academics? Students complete focused core work through adaptive learning tools that adjust to their level and pace. They advance after demonstrating mastery, while Guides monitor progress, coach goals, and provide support. How does Alpha Fort Worth combine academics with life skills? The daily model separates focused core academics from workshops and projects that build practical skills. This creates time for leadership, communication, collaboration, entrepreneurship, financial literacy, and relationship building. What do future-ready skills mean at Alpha Fort Worth? Future-ready skills are practical capabilities practiced through workshops: communicating clearly, collaborating, solving problems, leading teams, building relationships, showing grit, and applying entrepreneurial or financial thinking. What does accelerated learning mean at Alpha Fort Worth? Accelerated learning means a student can move through academic material at an appropriate pace after demonstrating mastery. It does not require every learner to move at the same speed or wait for a class calendar. Is Alpha Fort Worth a fit for advanced learners? The personalized mastery model can be relevant for advanced learners because students can move beyond material they have already mastered. Guides help students set goals, stay motivated, and receive support in areas that need more work. How should families compare Alpha Fort Worth with other private schools? Compare schools by grade scope, learning model, personalization, adult coaching, workshops, location, tuition, and admissions fit. Alpha’s distinctive combination is focused mastery-based academics plus structured life-skills development.
